channel.title: Kompas — News
channel.description: Key news on repression in Russia and against those who left: political prisoners, verdicts, new designations. Every item links to its source. Updated morning and evening.

item.title: Prosecutor seeks 5 years in absentia for Michael Naki over a video, 14 years in total with an earlier sentence
item.description: According to Mediazona, a prosecutor at Moscow's Basmanny court asked for 5 years for the blogger under Article 280.4. In 2023 a court sentenced him in absentia to 11 years for 'fakes'. — Mediazona

item.title: Primorye activist Maksim Chikhunov detained over a 2020 post with the 'I/WE Sergei Furgal' image
item.description: According to OVD-Info, Centre E officers took him to a police station. A report on displaying 'extremist' symbols is being drawn up against him. — OVD-Info

item.title: Nina Slobodchikova, jailed for 12 years for treason, drops her lawsuit against the penal colony without explaining why
item.description: According to OVD-Info, she was challenging her registration as 'prone to terrorism and extremism' at IK-9. At the hearing she cried and said she could not explain her decision with FSIN staff present. — OVD-Info

item.title: Olga Sidacheva-Shakhova from occupied Kherson region charged with espionage after an earlier sentence
item.description: According to Mediazona, she wrote in a letter that she is held in a pre-trial detention centre under Article 276. Earlier she was fined 320 thousand roubles for justifying terrorism over a social media comment. — Mediazona

item.title: Nizhnevartovsk man fined 60 thousand roubles over an anti-war TikTok and a comment about Putin
item.description: According to OVD-Info, the court imposed two fines of 30 thousand roubles for 'discrediting' the army and disrespect for the authorities after a video of a ballot with an anti-war message. — OVD-Info

item.title: Belarus: political prisoner Olga Britikova was put in a punishment cell
item.description: According to Mediazona Belarus, citing Viasna, the trade union activist was sent to a punishment cell for seven days in May. Her term is six years in a penal colony. — Mediazona Belarus

item.title: Idris Makhmudov, an organiser of a hunger strike in a US immigration prison, deported
item.description: Citing Agentstvo, Current Time reports that his representative said Makhmudov is in Morocco awaiting a flight to Russia. He helped organise a hunger strike at the prison in Folkston. — Current Time

item.title: Kirov court remands lawyer and blogger Anton Dolgikh in custody until 7 December
item.description: According to 7x7, the lawyer, who runs a blog criticising the security services and judges, was sent to pre-trial detention. He is accused of striking an FSIN officer in September. — 7x7

item.title: Proekt journalist Alexander Savelyev fined for taking part in an 'undesirable' organisation
item.description: According to Mediazona, the Ust-Labinsk district court fined him 10 thousand roubles over the outlet's 'Fathers and Grandfathers' investigation into nepotism. He has lived outside Russia since 2021. — Mediazona

item.title: Former prison monitor Igor Nagavkin released from a penal colony in Kamyshin after two years
item.description: According to 7x7, the human rights defender was released on 9 October. He had been given two years under Article 321 of the Criminal Code for disrupting the work of a detention facility; he called the prosecution revenge. — 7x7

item.title: Ornithologist Sofya Rozenfeld sentenced to three and a half years in a penal colony over donations to FBK
item.description: Moscow's Gagarinsky court convicted her under Part 1 of Article 282.3 of the Criminal Code and she was taken into custody after the verdict, OVD-Info reports, citing Mediazona. The prosecutor had asked for five years. — OVD-Info

item.title: Pavel Krisevich's wife has left Russia after two arrests and FSB pressure
item.description: According to Novaya Gazeta Europe, she has left Russia and is safe. In August she was detained in the Ryazan region and a court gave her ten days' arrest, then another 14. — OVD-Info

item.title: Warehouse cleaner near Moscow sentenced to 7 years for corresponding with the Freedom of Russia Legion
item.description: According to a Mediazona correspondent, the Moscow Regional Court convicted Sergei Bryantsev under Article 275.1 and Part 2(c) of Article 280.4 of the Criminal Code. The prosecutor had asked for 8 years; he did not plead guilty. — Mediazona

item.title: Cleaner at Voronezh's Borkhimmash plant sent to pre-trial detention over "pro-Ukrainian views"
item.description: According to Mediazona, a court in Voronezh in September sent 50-year-old Olga Usoltseva to pre-trial detention in a case of justifying terrorism. An FSB investigator cited her "pro-Ukrainian views". — Mediazona

item.title: Editor of Yekaterinburg outlet Nakanune Sergei Khurbatov fined 60 thousand roubles over a "fake"
item.description: According to Mediazona, the case was prompted by a rewrite of a news item quoting an economist on a possible rise in the pension age; the court applied Part 9 of Article 13.15 of the Administrative Code. — Mediazona

item.title: Defendant in the Artpodgotovka case Igor Sharnev tells court FSB officers tortured him
item.description: According to Sharnev, after his arrest officers beat him with stun guns and kicked him for several hours. He said this in the 2nd Western District Military Court, Mediazona reports. — OVD-Info

item.title: After the 4 October Communist Party rally in Moscow, courts fine nine detainees and jail four
item.description: According to OVD-Info, at least 13 detainees have been punished. About 60 people were taken to police stations, and six were fined ten thousand roubles each. — OVD-Info

item.title: Yabloko leader Nikolai Rybakov fined over anti-war messages written on ballot papers
item.description: Vyborg District Court in St Petersburg fined him a thousand roubles for petty hooliganism (Article 20.1, Part 1 of the Administrative Code), Mediazona reports. The case concerned four ballots with the words "for peace" and "for freedom". — OVD-Info

item.title: Irkutsk businessman Sergei Uglyanitsa remanded in custody in a case over "justifying terrorism"
item.description: Kirovsky District Court in Irkutsk sent him to a remand centre. He is accused of publicly justifying terrorism online (Article 205.2, Part 2 of the Criminal Code); what exactly he is charged with is unknown, Mediazona reports. — OVD-Info

item.title: Justice Ministry adds an activist, a film critic, bloggers and a Telegram channel to the "foreign agents" register
item.description: The new "foreign agents" include Novosibirsk activist Roman Malozemov, film critic Teymur Aliyev, blogger Muslim Satuyev, Ishmurat Khaibullin and the Telegram channel "Plokhaya kuryanochka", OVD-Info reports, citing Novaya Gazeta Europe. — OVD-Info

item.title: Ukrainian Lyubov Rozhanskaya released from detention in Astana and has already left Kazakhstan
item.description: She was detained at the airport on 1 October at Russia's request. Her lawyer says the detention period expired and no preventive measure was chosen. She was freed on 4 October and is heading to Odesa. — Novaya Gazeta Europe

item.title: Khabarovsk journalist Alexander Simontsev detained in the US; he and his family had applied for asylum
item.description: ICE officers detained him on a road in Arkansas, his wife said; where he was taken is unknown. According to her, hearings on the asylum case are scheduled for 2028. — Novaya Gazeta Europe

item.title: 18-year-old TikToker from Yekaterinburg jailed for nine days over a video about "searching for the cat Svoboda"
item.description: She was accused of organising an unauthorised event. According to the young woman, who spoke to the outlet Post-, she was questioned for about five hours and threatened with a criminal case. She is now free. — Novaya Gazeta Europe

item.title: UN Committee against Torture demands Kazakhstan not hand Yulia Emelyanova over to Russia
item.description: On 8 October the committee applied urgent measures on the complaint of the former Navalny campaign activist, her lawyer said. She remains in custody in Almaty and the extradition decision remains in force. — Novaya Gazeta Europe

item.title: 52-year-old political prisoner Igor Yakovenko, who had an inoperable brain tumour, has died in Krasnodar's SIZO-1
item.description: According to Memorial, he was examined a few days before his death and sent back to the remand centre for palliative care. He was reportedly beaten earlier in the same remand centre. — OVD-Info

item.title: Yabloko supporter Elena Perepelitsa gets 4 years in a penal colony for donating 3500 roubles to FBK
item.description: According to Mediazona, Moscow's Simonovsky court convicted her under Part 1 of Article 282.3 of the Criminal Code over seven transfers of 500 roubles. She is the fourth woman jailed for donations to FBK. — Mediazona

item.title: Political prisoner and saxophonist Andrei Shabanov was beaten twice in Samara's IK-10, his mother says
item.description: According to his mother, Olga Medvedeva, he is beaten for refusing cleaning duties despite his Group II disability. She believes the violence is linked to his complaints about prison conditions. — Novaya Gazeta Europe

item.title: Czech citizen Vitaly Demidchik, who came from Prague to visit his sick mother, detained in Belarus
item.description: According to Nasha Niva, he was detained after crossing the border on 30 June and is charged under Article 361-3 of the Criminal Code over transfers in support of Ukraine. He is held in SIZO No. 1 in Minsk. — Mediazona Belarus

item.title: 71-year-old Belarusian political prisoner Vatslav Oreshko has completely lost his sight in a penal colony
item.description: A relative reported this. Sentenced to 8 years in the trade union case, he fears transfer to hospital from penal colony No. 22, saying he may not survive it. — Mediazona Belarus

item.title: Lida Moniava to stay on as director of the Dom s Mayakom hospice after the criminal case is dropped
item.description: According to her lawyer Mikhail Biryukov, the investigator reported that the case over military "fakes" was dropped. Moniava still wears an electronic bracelet, to be removed once the penal service is notified. — Mediazona

item.title: Former police investigator in Nizhny Novgorod region charged with forging documents for asylum seekers
item.description: The case under Part 1 of Article 327 of the Criminal Code has reached the Moskovsky District Court of Nizhny Novgorod, Mediazona reports. The FSB claims he produced documents on political persecution for refugee status abroad. — Mediazona

item.title: Belarus prosecutor general: about 2 500 people convicted under "extremism" articles in a year and a half
item.description: According to Prosecutor General Dmitry Gora, about 2 000 criminal cases were opened in a year and a half. Since 2022, in absentia cases against more than 150 people have been sent to court. — Mediazona Belarus

item.title: Delfi: Latvia's foreign ministry decides to declare Russian journalist Leonid Ragozin persona non grata
item.description: According to Delfi, the journalist has lived in Latvia since 2014. Foreign Minister Baiba Braže said the decision was based on information from the competent authorities. — Meduza

item.title: Saratov journalist Elena Nalimova fined 30 thousand roubles under the "foreign agent" article
item.description: According to 7x7, the Kirovsky District Court of Saratov imposed the fine under Part 1 of Article 19.34 of the Administrative Code. On 28 September she was charged in a case of insulting the authorities. — 7x7

item.title: Tomsk Polytechnic University expels Anton Isakov, head of the local branch of the Rassvet party
item.description: According to 7x7, the TPU order cites "propaganda of banned ideologies". Isakov has gone to court to be reinstated as a student. — 7x7

item.title: Political prisoner Alexander Shestun reports a pre-heart-attack condition
item.description: According to OVD-Info, Shestun is on hunger strike and has lost more than 20 kilograms. He says he was given an ultimatum: end the hunger strike or go without medical care. — OVD-Info

item.title: Boris Grebenshchikov fined 15 thousand roubles over an interview with Meduza
item.description: According to Mediazona, Moscow's Khoroshevsky District Court fined the musician for cooperating with an “undesirable” organisation. Grebenshchikov left Russia in 2020 and lives in the UK. — Mediazona

item.title: Postgraduate Alexei Ptushkin sentenced to 5 years for two comments on the Kakhovka dam explosion
item.description: According to Mediazona, Moscow's Chertanovsky District Court convicted him under the military “fakes” article. Ptushkin was taken into custody in the courtroom. — Mediazona

item.title: Kaliningrad man who swam to Lithuania to seek asylum and was sent back gets 6 years in a penal colony
item.description: According to Mediazona, the Baltic Fleet Military Court sentenced a 68-year-old man from Neman to six years over anti-war posts. Lithuania's border service returned him to Russia the same day. — Mediazona

item.title: Scientist Sofya Rozenfeld sentenced to three and a half years in a penal colony for donations to FBK
item.description: According to Mediazona, Moscow's Gagarinsky District Court convicted her of financing an “extremist” organisation over two transfers made in 2021. She was taken into custody in the courtroom. — Mediazona
